name: Cloth Armor
summary: Well fashioned clothing, suited for most kinds of wear and able to provide slight protection.
text: Well fashioned clothing, suited for most kinds of wear and able to provide slight protection.

name: Leather Armor
summary: Sections of hardened animal hides laid over the body. Leather does not impede much but provides a great deal of protection.
text: Sections of hardened animal hides laid over the body. Leather does not impede much but provides a great deal of protection.
special: Sections of hardened animal hides laid over the body. Leather does not impede much but provides a great deal of protection.

name: Chain and Gambeson
summary: A flexible yet extremely protective network of linked metal rings. Chain impedes movement only a little and rarely breaks.
text: A flexible yet extremely protective network of linked metal rings. Chain impedes movement only a little and rarely breaks.
special: A flexible yet extremely protective network of linked metal rings. Chain impedes movement only a little and rarely breaks.

name: Dragon Armor
summary: The most protective Class of Armor, an overlapping array of metal scales and loops. Its sheer weight is a significant drawback unless the wearer can bear it.
text: The most protective Class of Armor, an overlapping array of metal scales and loops. Its sheer weight is a significant drawback unless the wearer can bear it.
special: The most protective Class of Armor, an overlapping array of metal scales and loops. Its sheer weight is a significant drawback unless the wearer can bear it.

name: Buckler
summary: A small dome of hardened steel fit to the hand, used to deflect more than really obstruct an Attack. Its size allows it to be tempered to a degree unfit for larger Shields, but its size makes it equally unfit for some tasks.
effects: The Hand used to Equip a Buckler is not considered full.
text: The Hand used to Equip a Buckler is not considered full.
special:

name: Heater
summary: Constructed to affix to cover the side and deflect most blows, Heaters are popular for their middle approach, neither too large nor small.
text: Constructed to affix to cover the side and deflect most blows, Heaters are popular for their middle approach, neither too large nor small.

name: Dragon Shield
summary: Like a wall, the Dragon Shield is a bulwark against nearly anything, but obscenely cumbersome. Its more popular use is to set up emplacements for archers, but some combatants choose to carry them.
effects: Everything in the Shield's Engagement benefits from T Cover, including the wearer. When this Cover causes something to miss, it always Damages the Shield.
